summary.text: Courtney Sappington is a Republican state representative from Douglas County who has represented Kansas House District 5 since her appointment in October 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026. In a Ballotpedia survey, she named property tax relief, deregulation and foster care reform among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Sappington graduated from Lee's Summit North High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Truman State University in 2009, and earned a graduate degree from the Thunderbird School of Global Management in 2011.
Her career experience includes working as an operations manager.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked in supply chain and sales operations before staying home with her children, and that she has served on the Baldwin City Recreation Commission board.
Sappington was appointed to the Kansas House on October 8, 2025, to succeed Representative Carrie Barth, and Ballotpedia lists her as taking office on October 13, 2025.
She said in the survey that she served on the Welfare Reform Committee.
She also said in the survey that she is most passionate about foster care reform and that property tax relief, deregulation, and rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse are among her priorities.
